topic: Which remote gh picks, unverified cases
detail: Low (SP-044 review rounds 1-2): gh only counts remotes on hosts it is signed in to. When gh is signed in to an Enterprise host only, it skips github.com remotes and may pick a later one; the check assumes github.com is known. The check counts gh api's {owner}/{repo} as the marked repo plus the first remotes, since gh api may ignore gh repo set-default (not checked against gh's source). Whether GitHub resolves dot segments in API paths is unverified; such paths fail closed.
